evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, render_units recursively lists all tracked files under ops/systemd and filters only by basename prefix, then writes each rendered template to output / source.name. Two tracked templates with the same basename in different subdirectories therefore render to the same target path; the later write silently overwrites the earlier one and paths reports duplicates. No duplicate-basename check exists before writing, so this is an ordinary correctness defect rather than a new requirement.
